title: Workspace settings
intro: Review your workspace information and bring in your content.
importIntro: Continue your notes from another tool. Choose where you are importing from.
importSummary: Read a ZIP containing Markdown and CSV from Notion or AppFlowy.
membersHint: Review current members, invitations and access in the sharing screen.
settingsBoundary: This screen does not change the workspace name or server connections. Choose appearance and language in personal preferences.
privateDestination: After review, the content is created as a new private page branch. Existing pages are not overwritten.
notionDescription: Inspect a Markdown & CSV ZIP exported from Notion.
notionLimit: Original sharing, history and every database setting cannot be reproduced. Review conversion support in the inspection screen.
appflowyDescription: Inspect an AppFlowy workspace ZIP and review the supported pages and databases.
appflowyLimit: For native archives, only the content shown in the inspection results is imported. This is not a full restoration of permissions, history or every setting.
guestHint: Guests cannot import into this workspace. Existing permissions still determine what you can read or share.
transferBoundary: Choose a file on the next screen to inspect the ZIP on this device. Selected content and attachments are sent only after you review the destination and give consent.
accountBoundary: Import into this account's workspace. Notes in the device demo and the original file remain unchanged.
invalidWorkspace: This workspace could not be identified. Open it again from your account.
accountsDisabled: Accounts are not enabled on this server.
signInRequired: Sign in to open workspace settings.
verifyRequired: Verify your email address before using this workspace.
contentDisabled: Account notes are not enabled on this server.
workspaceUnavailable: This workspace is unavailable. Check your current membership.
accountChanged: The signed-in account changed. Reload these settings.
unavailable: Settings could not be loaded. Check your connection and session, then reload.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
